courses.name: M.E./M.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering
aliases: Master of Technology in Computer Science and Engineering
Master of Engineering in Computer Science
courses.summary: The M.E./M.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering is a postgraduate engineering degree for graduates in computer science, information technology or a related branch. Coursework covers advanced algorithms, distributed and parallel systems, machine learning, computer networks, security and software systems, and many programmes offer specialisations such as artificial intelligence, data science or cyber security. The second year is usually a research dissertation or industry project. Programmes normally last two years, while integrated five-year versions admit students after secondary school.

universities.name: National Institute of Technical Teachers Training and Research, Chennai
universities.summary: NITTTR Chennai is a Ministry of Education institution at Taramani, established in 1964 and listed by UGC as a deemed university. Its taught postgraduate study combines engineering or business specialisation with a modular academic structure. Regular and working-professional routes have separate study arrangements.
universities.campusLifestyle: The Taramani campus supports postgraduate study, technical-teacher development and research. The Resource Centre provides print collections, electronic resources and research-support tools; current member access conditions apply.
universities.cityProfile: NITTTR is located at Taramani in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, postal code600113. Plan travel and accommodation around the Chennai teaching campus. Other NITTTR institutions at Bhopal, Chandigarh and Kolkata, and the listed extension centres in other cities, are distinct locations; their fees and admission rules should not be substituted.
universities.practicalExposure: The postgraduate regulations use an80-credit modular structure combining professional or elective courses, mandatory learning, practical work and project or dissertation components. Programme brochures describe subject-specific curricula. Review the exact curriculum, credit registration and assessment requirements for the selected degree; a project or internship component does not guarantee an employer placement or a teaching appointment.
universities.hostelOverview: The institute publishes guest-house and residence galleries, including Bharathidasan, Tiruppur Kumaran, Velu Nachiyar and DrRathakrishnan International Hall of Residence. Confirm whether regular PG students can receive a room, current availability, charges and written allotment terms; a published residence photograph does not establish a room guarantee.
universities.dietarySupport: Confirm current meal availability, mess charges and dietary or allergy requirements with the residence before booking. A programme fee quotation does not establish included meals.
universities.safetyOverview: The institute lists anti-ragging, grievance and internal-complaints support routes. Obtain the current campus and residence contacts at enrolment and confirm access and travel arrangements for your timetable.
universities.studentSupport: The Resource Centre provides research tools and member access to subscribed electronic resources. The academic admission portal sets out application, entrance assessment and document-verification steps; obtain the current programme checklist.

faq.question: Is this the Chennai NITTTR?
faq.answer: Yes. This profile covers NITTTR at Taramani, Chennai. Other NITTTR institutions and extension-centre locations have separate campus and admission arrangements.

faq.question: How long is regular postgraduate study?
faq.answer: The current programme directory identifies two-year postgraduate study. The regular route must be distinguished from flexible working-professional, online and doctoral arrangements.

faq.question: What qualification is needed?
faq.answer: Each engineering specialism has a named prior-degree list in the PG regulations. Business Analytics accepts a recognised bachelor degree of at least three years. The institute assesses equivalence and selection; a course title alone does not establish eligibility.

faq.question: How is the academic structure organised?
faq.answer: The postgraduate regulations describe a modular80-credit structure with subject courses, assessments and a project or dissertation component. Obtain the current programme curriculum and credit-registration plan.

faq.question: What does the programme fee cover?
faq.answer: The current schedule publishes a total fee for an80-credit PG programme and separately explains per-credit and examination rates, one-time fees, refundable deposits and annual facilitation charges. Confirm a personalised written schedule, extra study costs and accommodation before payment.

faq.question: Can overseas or NRI applicants assume admission is available?
faq.answer: No. The2026–27AICTE approval letter recordsNo in international and NRI approval columns for these regular degrees. General regulations mention a conditional foreign-government nomination procedure; that does not establish an ordinary international application route.

faq.question: Is a room guaranteed?
faq.answer: No room allocation is established by the published guest-house and residence galleries. Confirm eligibility, availability, charges and the exact residence before arranging accommodation.

faq.question: Is the teaching language established?
faq.answer: A programme-wide instruction and assessment language has not been confirmed in this source set. Request the exact language arrangements; no English assumption is made from the country or website.

faq.question: Is the application portal always open?
faq.answer: No. Admission notices and portal schedules are cohort-specific. Confirm the current application window, available regular seats and selection arrangements before submitting details or a payment.
